reason: Both plans satisfy every hard requirement (≤12 steps, rollback, rehearsal on non-production data, post-cutover integrity checks via row counts/checksums, stakeholder communication, and a full backup preceding the destructive cutover steps) with essentially equivalent technical soundness. Each has minor offsetting strengths — Response A's rollback narrative is slightly clearer about the untouched on-prem state, while Response B offers a more thorough upfront inventory, finer-grained cutover steps, and a documented lessons-learned close-out — leaving no clear overall winner on task performance.
